name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+3

- Beta 1: speed and reliability
  - Progress is sent to Stremio as soon as the app goes to the background, so closing it mid-episode loses nothing
  - Updates that fail while offline are kept on the phone and sent later (a newer copy on Stremio wins)
  - Continue Watching refreshes when you come back to the app
  - Library refresh downloads only the items that changed, not the whole library
  - Home rows from addons that aren't responding are skipped
  - Info tab answers (Simkl, TMDB, TVmaze) are saved on the phone for 7 days
  - Over the image-cache limit, the oldest images are removed instead of all of them
  - Missing settings and leftover print() calls no longer fill the log file
  - Self Test shows launch time and any Stremio updates waiting to send
  - iOS 15 minimum (drops the bundled Swift concurrency library)
  - iPhone builds reuse CocoaPods and Rust package downloads; release notes list each change
